verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI says the same agent can run 'on a durable background queue,' and its durable execution handles long-running, asynchronous workflows that survive failures and restarts. It also positions itself for long-running coding and research agents. As a code-first framework, though, it gives you the building blocks rather than a ready automation feature: there is no documented scheduler, trigger, or no-code setup, so you must wire and host the background runs yourself. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling or event triggers for automations, a turnkey setup experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.
